comparison.configuration: 2D Release -O2, PCH ON, LTO OFF, compiler cache OFF, mold linker
comparison.dependencies: Prebuilt pinned third-party libraries retained; shader outputs/generated embedding retained. All reachable Kin and game compile outputs, including PCHs, removed before each build.

environment.cpu: Intel Core i9-13900HX, 32 logical CPUs visible

method.execution: Sequential Ninja -j4 hex_demo invocations in separate before/after build directories. No benchmark builds overlap. Compiler/feature flags were matched after normalizing build/source paths.
method.scope: Rebuild all Kin and hex_demo compile outputs reachable from the game target, including PCHs, then archive/link the runtime libraries and game. Third-party libraries, shaders, generated embedding, and CMake configuration are already built.
method.cleaning: Extract -c/-o pairs from ninja -t commands hex_demo. Remove only outputs compiling sources in the Kin worktree, or generated sources in the build engine/games directories. Leave external dependency outputs intact.
method.wall_and_cpu: GNU time around Ninja records wall time, summed child user/system CPU time and max child RSS. Max child RSS is the largest process peak, not total simultaneous memory.
method.task_traces: New entries in .ninja_log retain compiler/PCH/archive/link task start/end times. Task wall time can include waiting for CPU/I/O and is not per-task CPU time.

validation.implementation_checks: The preceding split commit separately passed 9 selected tests per compiler, preserved all 47 component schemas/defaults, and passed feature-disabled/3D compile checks. This phase changes documentation/data only.

limits: One paired observation per compiler; small differences may reflect host load, scheduler choices on hybrid CPU cores, filesystem/cache effects and thermal behavior.
Not a fresh checkout build: dependency compilation, shader generation and initial configuration are excluded.
Results apply to this 2D configuration at four jobs. No whole-project 3D, MSVC, or other parallelism measurements were made.
Installed GCC and Clang have different implicit hardening/padding defaults. Cross-compiler totals do not isolate the compiler implementation; within-compiler before/after settings match.
Per-process RSS does not establish total parallel build memory.
